landing.hero.eyebrow: Step by step to your own system.
landing.hero.title: Learn to think like an engineer. Shape technology freely.
landing.hero.lead: GerNetiX does not simply remove complexity. You learn to understand and master it in manageable steps – so you can choose hardware and software consciously, integrate your own hardware and freely shape distributed systems.
landing.overview.title: Where would you like to begin?
landing.overview.text: Learning and development are not separate worlds. Start in either area and move between them whenever it helps.
landing.overview.learning.title: Understand, experiment and keep building.
landing.overview.learning.text: Guided learning projects connect accessible fundamentals with practical steps – from your first experiment to the complete system.
landing.overview.ide.title: Develop your own systems in one place.
landing.overview.ide.text: Plan, configure and develop your project with your own hardware as a connected system – from the microcontroller through the application to the backend.
landing.shared.title: Knowledge and exchange
landing.shared.text: The knowledge portal and community are not extra paths you have to choose between. They support you while learning and while developing.
landing.shared.knowledge.label: Reference
landing.shared.knowledge.title: Knowledge portal
landing.shared.knowledge.text: Look up terms, fundamentals and methods.
landing.shared.community.label: Exchange
landing.shared.community.title: Community
landing.shared.community.text: Ask questions, share experience and show projects.
landing.nexi.title: Nexi: a voice assistant to build yourself
landing.nexi.text: Build the voice assistant publicly, understand its technology in the learning area and use the development area when you want to turn it into your own idea.
landing.nexi.step1.title: Build and experiment
landing.nexi.step1.text: Start with the hardware and local firmware without an account.
landing.nexi.step2.title: Understand it in the learning area
landing.nexi.step2.text: Explore its components and connections step by step.
landing.nexi.step3.title: Extend it in the development area
landing.nexi.step3.text: Turn your own functions into a complete system.
landing.motivation.title: Understanding makes you independent.
landing.motivation.text1: Technology changes constantly. Understanding the underlying connections keeps you independent of individual vendors, programming languages and trends.
landing.motivation.text2: That is why learning and development belong together at GerNetiX: build knowledge, apply it in practice and make sound decisions for your own system.
landing.motivation.evolution: Software development became faster with every abstraction: from punch cards through assembly and higher-level languages such as Fortran, BASIC and Pascal to C/C++, Java and Python. Libraries and frameworks made reusable technology available – from windows with MFC or Qt to browser applications without traditional installation.
landing.motivation.ai: AI is the next leap: it can derive drafts, code and tests from a good description. It does not remove the need to clarify the right goal, weigh consequences and verify the result. Tools become faster – thinking and responsibility remain.
landing.motivation.conclusion: Those who understand can develop. And those who can develop can create.
landing.motivation.approach1.label: Different ways to learn
landing.motivation.approach1.text: Reading, experimenting and thinking together reinforce one another – without a rigid mandatory program.
landing.motivation.approach2.label: Technology with responsibility
landing.motivation.approach2.text: AI can explain and assist. Weighing options, deciding and verifying remain part of your own capability.
landing.scope.title: From the embedded device to the application
landing.scope.text: Understand the components in the learning area. Bring them together into your own system in the development area.
landing.scope.device.title: Embedded system
landing.scope.device.text: An embedded system reads sensors, controls actuators and runs firmware close to the hardware.
landing.scope.gateway.title: Local server
landing.scope.gateway.text: A local server connects devices on the local network, consolidates data and can run rules even without internet access.
landing.scope.cloud.title: Cloud & services
landing.scope.cloud.text: Cloud services provide secure APIs, synchronization and cross-account functions when they are needed.
landing.scope.app.title: Application
landing.scope.app.text: Web and mobile apps make status and control understandable to use. AI can support development and analysis; responsibility remains with people.

about.title: Education meets electrical engineering.
about.intro: We are a married couple. One of us brings teacher training and educational experience, while the other is a graduate electrical engineer. GerNetiX combines both: sharing knowledge in a way that makes technical depth understandable and useful in practice.
about.education.title: People learn in different ways.
about.education.text: Some people need an example first, while others want to understand the theory or discuss a question. That is why GerNetiX combines clear reading material, small steps, practical projects and personal guidance.
about.engineering.title: Good solutions begin with the right questions.
about.engineering.text: Electrical engineering, embedded software, networks, apps and servers are not treated as isolated islands. We show how requirements, limits and decisions shape a complete system.
about.principle.title: AI reduces the workload – but it does not replace thinking.
about.principle.text1: AI can generate source code, explain examples and accelerate designs. A person must still judge whether a solution fits the task, is safe and respects its technical limits.
about.principle.text2: That is why GerNetiX does not teach rigid recipes. You learn to clarify requirements, weigh options, justify decisions and verify results.
about.conclusion: Those who understand can develop. And those who can develop can create.
flashbox.page.title: Set up FlashBox · GerNetiX
flashbox.intro.title: What is the FlashBox for?
flashbox.intro.text: The FlashBox is a Wi-Fi-to-USB/serial bridge. It helps you flash IoT devices over Wi-Fi when you use an iPad, Android device or a computer without USB serial support.
flashbox.intro.compare: OTA: The device is already connected to Wi-Fi and receives firmware directly. USB: A computer is connected directly to the device. FlashBox: It brings the USB connection to you over Wi-Fi – ideal for new devices without Wi-Fi or direct USB access.
flashbox.steps.label: Setup steps
flashbox.connect.title: 1. Connect the FlashBox
flashbox.connect.text: Connect the FlashBox via Control USB. If necessary, hold BOOT and briefly press RESET.
flashbox.connect.port_label: USB port of the installed Serial Helper
flashbox.connect.hint: The browser asks once for access to the USB/serial device. For security reasons, a website cannot scan COM ports invisibly.
flashbox.hardware.title: 2. Check hardware
flashbox.release.title: 3. Approved initial image
flashbox.release.confirm: I confirm that the board, flash and RAM information matches my FlashBox.
flashbox.result.title: 4. Result
flashbox.result.hint: Writing the initial image does not itself create a sign-in, account or ownership assignment.
flashbox.account.title: 5. Connect to account
flashbox.account.text: Assign the configured FlashBox to your account using the claim code from your order. After signing in, you will go directly to the device inventory for account assignment.

flashbox.dialog.mac_text: This browser cannot access the USB port directly. On a Mac, you have two options:
flashbox.dialog.helper_text: Install the GerNetiX Serial Service once. GerNetiX can then use the serial USB port through the local helper.
